home.why_title: A home that takes care of the little things.
home.why_text: Your devices stop working alone and start working together, so your home adapts to your routine.
home.ben1_text: Light and temperature are ready when you get home, without touching a thing.
home.ben2_text: One phrase can do what used to take ten small tasks around the house.
home.ben3_text: Lights and AC can follow your schedule. ENERGY STAR estimates a smart thermostat saves about 8% on heating and cooling bills.
home.ben4_text: Check your door and cameras from your phone, wherever you are.
home.ben5_text: Use your voice, your phone or a wall panel. Everyone at home can use it.
home.ben6_text: Start with what matters most and add more whenever you want.
home.prod1_text: Talk to your home. Ask for a scene, the temperature or the lights from any room.
home.prod2_text: Open with a code or your phone, and give temporary access to guests.
home.prod3_text: Change brightness and color for every moment, or let them turn on by themselves.
home.prod4_text: Keep the temperature you like at home and adjust it from anywhere.

home.prod5_text: Open with the morning and close at sunset, by schedule or by voice.
home.prod6_text: See what is happening at home from your phone and get alerts when there is movement.

smart.title: Your home, working for you.
smart.intro: Home automation is not about having more gadgets. It is about having a home that makes your day easier.
smart.what_text: A smart home connects your lights, lock, thermostat, curtains, cameras and sensors so they work together. You control them with your voice, your phone or a wall panel, and many things can happen on their own by schedule or when something changes.
smart.change_title: The same day, without the little tasks.
smart.change1_before: Looking for keys in the dark, in a hot house.
smart.change1_after: Code at the door, lights on, house already cool.
smart.change2_before: Walking through the house turning everything off.
smart.change3_before: Wondering if you left the door open or the lights on.
smart.change3_after: Check it on your phone and fix it from there.
smart.change4_before: Copying keys or waiting at home for someone to arrive.
smart.change4_after: A temporary code for each person.
smart.stats_title: More homes are already doing it.
smart.stat1: of U.S. internet households own at least one smart home device.
smart.stat2: smart devices on average in homes that have them.
smart.stat3: average savings on heating and cooling bills with a smart thermostat, about $50 per year.
smart.ha_text: Home Assistant is the brain we use to connect your home. It is open source software that runs on a device inside your house, not only on a company's servers.
smart.ha1_text: It can keep working when the internet is down, as long as the devices connect locally. Some services, such as voice assistants or cloud cameras, may still need internet.
smart.ha2_text: It connects products from different brands, so one app can replace many.
smart.ha3_text: You can add devices and automations over time without starting over.
smart.faq1_a: Yes. Start with a plan or a few devices and add more whenever you want.
smart.faq2_a: Usually 2 to 3 days of design and 1 to 3 days of installation, depending on the plan and your home.
smart.faq3_q: What is the difference between Normal and Premium?
smart.faq3_a: Normal uses reliable, more basic products. Premium uses higher-end products with better finishes and more features.
smart.faq4_q: Does it only work with iPhone and Siri?
smart.faq4_a: No. Tell us what phones you use at home and we will recommend the right voice assistant.
smart.faq5_q: What happens if the internet goes down?
smart.faq5_a: Devices connected locally can keep working through Home Assistant. Features that depend on the cloud, including some voice commands and remote access, may stop until it comes back. We explain this for your specific products.
smart.faq6_q: Do you work with apartments and businesses?
smart.faq6_a: Yes. We work with houses, apartments and businesses in the Miami area.
smart.faq7_a: It depends on your home and the products you choose. We visit and send you a clear quote.

about.title: We make homes easier to live in.
about.mission: To automate your home so it becomes a more comfortable, welcoming place that makes your life easier.
about.vision: To be the company that equips and automates the most homes in Miami.
about.story_text: MaGaRo Fix It was founded by Mario Galban, a software and automation engineer who builds control and data acquisition systems for industry. He brings that same attention to detail to every home: every device is planned, tested and explained.
about.value1_text: You know what we will install and what it costs before we begin.
about.value2_text: We respect your home and leave everything tidy and tested.
about.value3_text: We explain everything in English or Spanish, in simple words.
about.what_title: We turn your home into a smart home.
about.what_text: We design and install smart home systems for houses, apartments and small businesses, and connect everything so it works as one. We also take care of what supports it: TV, WiFi, printers and IT support.
about.check6: Professional tools, ready at your door
